answer: Beacon-decay bond: each identity locks 600 credits in a walnut shell on an island account. Each epoch a beacon tide sweeps the islands; a keyed answer keeps it whole. A miss cracks the walnut, losing 8%; each crack enters a public tide ledger auditors recompute. Three misses break it; the bond burns. 1,000 fakes lock 600,000, bleeding 48,000 per idle tide; a rented pulse cannot sign for another key. Honest agents pay once, keep it by working.
